style: Flat graphic illustration in the style of a bold linocut / woodblock print. Thick dark ink outlines (#16150F), flat color fills, a limited palette of at most 5 colors per image built on cream paper tones with one or two vivid accents, subtle paper grain, slightly rough printed edges. Charming, characterful and a little fierce, like a collectible game emblem. No text, no letters, no watermark, no frame, no border.
formatAvatar: Format: square 1:1. A single character or emblem centered, filling about 70% of the frame with safe margins on every side, on a plain flat solid background of color {fond}. It will be cropped into a circle, so keep everything inside the central circle. One image only.
formatCouverture: Format: wide banner 16:9. Keep the key subject inside the middle horizontal band (central 40% of the height) because the top and bottom will be cropped. Atmospheric wide scene, no close-up faces. One image only.

objets.sujet: A cute but fierce baby white wolf pup, head and shoulders, big expressive eyes, fluffy fur, wearing a tiny red scarf.
A clever black raven perched with its head turned, holding a tiny rolled scroll tied with a ribbon in its beak.
A heraldic shield emblem showing a golden sponge and a bucket crossed like swords, a small crown on top, frosty decorative edge.
A burning torch with a bright orange flame and swirling sparks, handle wrapped in cloth, a few snowflakes around it.
A majestic large grey northern wolf, head and shoulders, stern gaze, thick fur collar with snowflakes on the fur.
A small brave knight in a dented steel helmet with a plume, holding a giant sponge like a sword and a bucket as a shield, heroic pose.
A baby dragon with tiny wings hatching from a cracked egg, a small puff of smoke from its nostrils, big curious eyes, silver and teal scales.
A hooded mystic in a dark cloak, three ravens perched on the shoulders, softly glowing eyes under the hood.
An elegant silver dragon coiled in a circle, wings folded, icy blue eyes, frost breath curling, fine scale details.
A regal queen with long pale braided hair and a silver crown, a small dragon curled around her shoulders, calm commanding expression, ice-blue and silver cloak.
A guard in a black hooded cloak with a fur collar, holding a long broom like a spear, a lantern at the belt, snow falling, stern pose.
A grand throne built from hundreds of brooms and crossed swords, a tall fan-shaped back made of broom bristles, golden accents, snow on top, imposing and humorous.
A wide snowy plain under a pale pink and blue winter sky, a lone bare tree in the center, distant soft hills, falling snow.
A pine forest at dusk in deep blue and purple tones, three wolf silhouettes standing on a ridge in the center, a full moon behind them.
A night sky full of stars over jagged snowy mountains, two dragons soaring across the middle, a glow of embers, deep indigo with orange accents.
A vast stone hall with tall arched windows letting in golden light, in the center a throne of brooms and swords on steps, banners hanging, dust motes floating, gold and deep brown.
